summary.text: Christopher Marte has represented Lower Manhattan on the New York City Council since 2022, in a district that includes the Lower East Side, Chinatown, the Financial District, Battery Park City, Tribeca and Soho.
His Council biography says he chairs the Subcommittee on Landmarks, Public Sitings, Resiliency and Dispositions and co-chairs the Black, Latino, Asian Caucus.

paragraphs.text: Marte was born and raised on the Lower East Side, and his Council biography says gentrification forced his father's bodega to close and many relatives to move away.
He left a career in finance after the Black Lives Matter movement began and became involved in community organizing before running for the Council.

As a Council Member, the biography says, he has helped tenants halt illegal evictions and get repairs, worked on wage theft in the home care industry, and supported legislation to end the 24-hour shift.
